description.value:
You have been exposed to so many chemicals that they pose little risk to you, and you can use them to quickly end certain ailments:

  • You gain Resistance to acid damage and poison damage, and you are Immune to the Poisoned condition.
  • You can cast Greater Restoration and Heal without expending a spell slot, without preparing the spell, and without material components, provided you have alchemist's supplies on your person. Once you cast either spell with this feature, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a Long Rest.
  • Potent Healing: When you cast an Artificer spell that restores hit points, you treat the spell as two spell levels higher for the purpose of determining the amount of hit points restored.
